Join us at Catalina Jazz Club on Sunday, October 18, for a special Jazz & Afro-Cuban Jazz Flute Summit, featuring Fay Roberts, Sheila Del Bosque and Gil Tower as they celebrate Webb's remarkable artistry and the lasting influence of his music.
